name: copy-field
summary: A selectable read-only value with progressive clipboard feedback.

agent.useWhen: Users need to transfer a displayed non-secret identifier or value exactly.
agent.avoidWhen: The value is editable, sensitive, or ordinary selection is sufficient. Native readiness covers literal static-page declarations, not runtime bindings or live-region replacement.

invariants: The native read-only input is the only clipboard source and remains selectable without JavaScript.
Feedback is literal localized text; clipboard content is never emitted in events.
Native/app owns submission, validation, and authorization; this component creates no operation.
Reserve control, hint, and status IDs. Async feedback cannot mutate detached or replaced specimens.
Browser enhancement and import-graph host admission must be proven before ready registration.
